exceptions.mitigation: The package is build tooling only. PR builds use ephemeral hosted runners with read-only tokens, no secrets, and no persisted checkout credentials. Never move these builds to privileged runners; remove the exception when Metro publishes a patched path.
exceptions.reason: Supersedes advisory 1138808, which the advisory database re-issued under this ID (GHSA-5p2g-fcmc-qvqq). React Native 0.86.2 pins Metro 0.84.4, which pins image-size 1.2.1. The fix exists only in image-size 2.0.3 and later, across a major boundary, and the 1.x line ends at 1.2.1, so no patched release exists inside Metro's ^1.0.2 range. Remove this exception when Metro moves to a patched range.

exceptions.mitigation: The package is test and build tooling only; neither SDK package has runtime dependencies. Glob patterns come from repository configuration, never from untrusted input. PR builds use ephemeral hosted runners with read-only tokens and no secrets. Remove the exception when braces publishes a fixed release.
exceptions.reason: GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm affects every braces release up to and including 3.0.3, which is the latest published version, so no patched release exists to resolve to.

exceptions.mitigation: The package is release tooling only and is reached only when a PAC proxy script is fetched over ftp://. Never configure release runs with an FTP-hosted PAC proxy. Do not force basic-ftp across the major boundary; remove the exception when get-uri accepts a patched range.
exceptions.reason: GHSA-c475-qrg2-pj4r is fixed only in basic-ftp 6.2.1 and later. Every get-uri release, including the latest 8.0.1, depends on basic-ftp ^5, so no patched release exists inside the range the dependency chain accepts.

exceptions.mitigation: The package is confined to the private example app's local Metro development server and is not shipped by either SDK package. Do not expose the Metro development server beyond localhost. Resolve body-parser@npm:^2.2.2 to 2.4.0 once it clears the cooldown on 2026-10-29, together with qs 6.16.1 and content-type 2.1.0, which 2.4.0 requires.
exceptions.reason: GHSA-27r3-jxmh-p828 is fixed only in body-parser 2.4.0, published 2026-10-22, inside the 7-day npmMinimalAgeGate. The fix is deliberately not fast-tracked past the dependency cooldown. The 2.4.0 tarball has been reviewed: it matches the upstream v2.4.0 tag and carries verified npm provenance.

observations.mitigation: Do not force uuid across a major boundary. Monitor xcode for a compatible update and retain the install-time execution controls.
observations.reason: The vulnerable buffer-writing forms of uuid v3, v5, and v6 are not reachable. xcode 3.0.1 imports only uuid.v4() without a caller-provided buffer.

observations.mitigation: Keep the example app free of unbounded attacker-controlled query strings. Monitor React Navigation and query-string for a compatible fixed dependency range.
observations.reason: Forcing the fixed 0.5.0 release breaks query-string 7.1.3 at runtime because the decoder's module API changed. This dependency is confined to the private example app and is not shipped by either SDK package.
